title: Telemetry review
description: Review a PR for user-facing changes and suggest required telemetry events and properties.

values.name: Telemetry review
values.prompt: Review the current PR diff for user-facing product changes. Identify whether telemetry is required for new or changed feature usage, feature states, settings enablement, staff/non-staff analysis, unique-user analysis, and user-visible failure states. If telemetry is needed, draft concrete event names, safe low-cardinality properties, restricted properties for sensitive diagnostics, and the frontend or backend owner for each event. If telemetry is not needed, explain why.
